verdict.rationale: CrewAI is primarily a Python framework/CLI where the 'UI' is mostly the Visual Agent/Task Builder and Crew Studio (CrewAI AMP/Enterprise), which are no-code/low-code interfaces; while deployed crews can be accessed via REST API and webhooks (crewai-docs-42, crewai-docs-52, crewai-docs-43), there's no evidence that the visual builder's design/configuration actions themselves are exposed as an API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (crewai-probe-3), so API-UI parity is not demonstrated. missing for 10: OpenAPI/API spec proving parity, evidence that Visual Agent/Task Builder actions are API-triggerable, independent confirmation of REST API completeness relative to UI features.
